title: Terminal Illness & End-of-Life Planning in Azerbaijan: 5-Step Official Checklist
titleEn: Terminal Illness & End-of-Life Planning in Azerbaijan: 5-Step Official Checklist
cardSummary: Official 5-step serious and terminal illness checklist for Azerbaijan: palliative care coordination, advance directives, powers of attorney, disability and caregiver support, and estate preparation.
introHtml: Coordinating care and administrative affairs for a seriously or terminally ill family member in Azerbaijan brings together state health agencies, notarial representation, and social protection benefits [1] [3] [9]. Because medical decision-making capacity and mobility can narrow rapidly, we outline five practical steps to put healthcare support, legal authority, disability allowances, and estate records in place early [1] [2].

steps.title: Organize medical care, palliative support, and insurance coverage
steps.html:
• Confirm primary clinical pathway and coverage: Under the Law on Protection of Health of the Population, public medical facilities coordinated by the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Azerbaijan and TABIB (Administration of the Regional Medical Divisions) deliver inpatient, outpatient, and pain-management care, while mandatory health insurance benefits are administered by the State Agency on Mandatory Health Insurance [1] [10] [11].
  • Establish informed consent and information sharing: The Law on Protection of Health sets patient rights regarding medical diagnosis disclosure, informed consent, and refusal of interventions; active euthanasia is prohibited under Azerbaijani law, so clinical care centers on symptom and palliative relief [1].
  • Prepare emergency contacts: Save the 112 emergency service (and 103 ambulance dispatch) alongside the treating hospital's ward contact for rapid clinical escalation [12].

steps.title: Execute a notarized power of attorney while the patient has capacity
steps.html:
• Appoint a trusted representative: Under the Civil Code of the Republic of Azerbaijan and the Law on Notariat, a person with full legal capacity can grant a notarized power of attorney (etibarnama) authorizing a family member to manage bank accounts, deal with state bodies, and sign administrative filings [2] [3].
  • Inpatient bedside certification under Article 73.2: Where the patient cannot travel to an ASAN Service center or notary office, mobile notarial services are available, and under the Civil Code a power of attorney executed by a patient undergoing inpatient hospital treatment may be certified by the chief or senior physician of the medical institution [2] [6].
  • Plan for capacity loss: Because Azerbaijani law does not maintain an independent standalone living-will registry, clarifying care preferences directly with attending physicians while executing a civil power of attorney helps avoid court-ordered guardianship delays [1] [2].

steps.title: Apply for disability assessment and social benefits
steps.html:
• Request medical-social disability evaluation: When an illness severely limits daily functioning, request an electronic medical-social expertise referral through the treating polyclinic or TABIB hospital so entitlement to disability status, pension adjustments, or social allowances under the Law on Social Benefits and Law on Labour Pensions can be assessed [4] [5] [11].
  • Coordinate via DOST Centers: Families can check eligibility for disability allowances, caregiving support, and social services through the DOST Agency and State Social Protection Fund centers (call center 142) without visiting multiple separate district counters [5] [8].
  • Keep identity and medical records aligned: Ensure the patient's ID card, bank card, and electronic health records show matching personal identification numbers (FIN) to prevent automated benefit interruptions [8] [10].

steps.title: Draft or review wills, asset inventories, and beneficiary records
steps.html:
• Execute a notarized will if desired: Under Article 1166 of the Civil Code, a capable adult may specify how property passes by drawing up a written will certified by a notary (via an ASAN Service center or district notary office) [2] [3] [6].
  • Understand mandatory statutory shares: In the absence of a valid will, Article 1159 distributes the estate equally among first-order heirs (children, spouse, and parents); if a will is made, check forced-heirship rules with the notary to prevent later challenges [2].
  • Compile a central document file: Keep property title extracts, bank details, pension registration numbers, and any marriage or birth certificates in one folder; if documents must later be accepted outside Azerbaijan, confirm Apostille procedures through the Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Azerbaijan (10 AZN state duty) [6] [7] [13].

steps.title: Clarify tax and debt obligations in advance
steps.html:
• Family inheritance income-tax exemption: Reassure family members that Azerbaijan imposes no standalone inheritance tax; under Article 102.1.3.2 of the Tax Code, property inherited or gifted from family members is exempt from personal income tax [9].
  • Document outstanding obligations: Under Article 80 of the Tax Code and Civil Code estate liability rules, future estate transfers carry existing tax or creditor obligations only up to the value of inherited property, so listing loan agreements, tax accounts, and utility contracts now streamlines later administration [2] [9].

prefillQuestion: A family member is facing a serious or terminal illness in Azerbaijan. We need an overview of the main official steps and contacts in Azerbaijan for palliative care, powers of attorney, advance directives, and caregiver support.

contacts.name: DOST Agency and State Social Protection Fund
contacts.note: One-stop social protection centers (call center 142) handling disability benefits, pensions, and caregiver or social service applications.

contacts.name: ASAN Service
contacts.note: Call center 108 arranges public services, mobile service requests, and notarial appointments for wills and powers of attorney.

contacts.name: Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Azerbaijan
contacts.note: Regulates licensed notaries, Mobile Notary services, and apostille authentication (10 AZN fee).

contacts.name: Ministry of Health of the Republic of Azerbaijan
contacts.note: National healthcare policy authority overseeing clinical treatment protocols alongside TABIB hospital facilities and emergency 112 dispatch.
